O processo é desenhado uma vez, vira man: The process is designed once, becomes a manual and training, and people carry it out. It rarely changes, because changing it means retraining everyone. A good part of what exists in your company today was born this way, with the tools and people of another era.
Um sistema passa a fazer parte das etapa: A system becomes part of the steps, and someone monitors whether it is running. The design stays the same as before: the automation copies the path people used to follow. This is where the risk of speeding up the error is born.
